subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All pages are crows.

Some crows are remotes.

Conclusion:

(I): Some pages are remotes.

(II): All crows are pages.
solution:

Conclusion:**
(I): Some pages are remotes. - False (All pages are crows.Some crows are remotes.As their is no relation between pages and remote may be it is possible but not definite. Hence, it is false)

(II): All crows are pages. - False (All pages are crows.Some crows are remotes. Hence, it is false)

Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"**
